description: Members are people with project administration access according to their role. Use the project owner key to invite, list or revoke them; viewer and approver roles have narrower access than admins. Invites expire after 72 hours and their links and accepted keys are shown once; listing returns no secrets. Revocation invalidates a key or pending invite and is safe to repeat. Gate sends no email. For dedicated approval keys use gate_create_approver, gate_list_approvers and gate_revoke_approver.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

operation.description: Perform exactly one operation: invite, list, revoke.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

role.description: Invited member role: viewer, approver, or admin.
